pin.description: Repeats the top-level rebaseWhen: Renovate's built-in pin config sets behind-base-branch, which would override it for pin updates, so a pin PR would rebase, and run CI with its E2E job, on every main move (#515).

packageRules.description: Auto-merge pin, digest and lockFileMaintenance updates once CI passes. The weekly group:allNonMajor rule below auto-merges every minor and patch update (#544).

Hold devalue below 6: SvelteKit 3 depends on devalue ^5.9.4, and its streaming serializer throws 'Invalid JavaScript fragment' under devalue 6. CI stays green unless a route streams a promise. Lift this once SvelteKit moves to devalue 6.

Hold typescript below 7 (#619): TypeScript 7.0 drops the TypeScript 6 JavaScript API (its '.' export, lib/version.cjs, holds only version and versionMajorMinor), and typescript-eslint, svelte-check and @sveltejs/kit call that API, so bun run check and bun run lint fail under 7. Lift this rule once npm view <pkg>@latest peerDependencies accepts ^7 for each of typescript-eslint, svelte-check and @sveltejs/kit. The name match is exact, so typescript-eslint is not held.

Open no major update for package.json overrides (#474): an override forces its version onto every consumer in the tree, so a new major lands on packages that declare the old one. Renovate raised the nanoid override from ^3 to ^6 while postcss, its only consumer, declares nanoid ^3 (6bbd6cc), and later proposed @opentelemetry/core v3 the same way (#459). Move an override's major by hand, once bun.lock shows that every consumer accepts it.

Open no PR for ghcr.io/renovatebot/renovate, the image of .forgejo/workflows/renovate-config.yml: that job must run the Renovate the bot runs. The bot's tag (image: in renovate/renovate-config's .forgejo/workflows/renovate.yml) moves only when someone merges that repo's image PR, which does not automerge. Move this repo's tag to the bot's new one at the same time.

Open the group:allNonMajor PR once a week, in the lockFileMaintenance window (Monday before 4am UTC), and auto-merge it once CI passes. A group auto-merges only when every update in it does, so this covers production minors too. Security PRs skip this schedule and the group, since Renovate forces its vulnerabilityAlerts defaults onto them, but keep this auto-merge (#465).

One Bun for CI, production and the Docker image (#528): the setup-bun bun-version inputs and railpack.json (npm package bun) move with the Dockerfile's oven/bun tags in one PR, for every update type, so scripts/check-bun-pins.sh stays green. This rule comes after the group:allNonMajor rules so it overrides their group, and it sets groupSlug because the preset's groupSlug would otherwise keep bun on renovate/all-minor-patch. A group of its own keeps a red bun PR (npm publishes a Bun before its Docker tag exists) from holding the weekly group. Same weekly window as that group.

customManagers.description: Read the production Bun pin, packages.bun in railpack.json, which no built-in manager reads, as the npm package bun: the datasource and name the github-actions manager gives setup-bun's bun-version input (#528).
